newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Three killed in Pakistani mosque attack.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Pakistani mosque attack.

text.p: At least three people were killed and one wounded in an attack on a Sunni Moslem mosque in the Pakistani city of Faisalabad, police said on Wednesday.
They said unidentified gumen fired at worshippers at Qadri mosque in Faisalabad, about 300 km (188 miles) south of Islamabad, on Tuesday evening.
Witnesses quoted by the official APP news agency said two men on a motorcycle stopped near the mosque. One went inside and fired at worshippers while the other stood guard outside.
No-one has claimed responsibility for the shooting.

Police described the attack as non-sectarian "terrorism", but Faisalabad residents said it could be part of a long-running feud between militant groups of Pakistan's Sunni Moslem majority and Shi'ite Moslem minority.
The feud has cost more than 40 lives so far this year.
